title: Elephant
description: An elephant wants to visit his friend located at point x on the coordinate line. In one step, the elephant can move 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 positions forward. Determine the minimum number of steps required to reach point x from point 0.
input_format: The first line contains a single integer x (1 ≤ x ≤ 1,000,000) — the coordinate of the friend's house.
output_format: Output a single integer — the minimum number of steps the elephant needs to make to reach point x.
expected_approach: To minimize the number of steps, the elephant should take as many steps of length 5 as possible. The remaining distance can be covered with one additional step if it's non-zero.

test_cases.explanation: The elephant can reach point 5 in one step of length 5.
The elephant can take two steps of length 5 and one step of length 2 to reach point 12.
The elephant can reach point 1 in one step of length 1.
